blocks.text: Machine learning is used in many areas of modern life. It helps organizations analyze large amounts of data quickly, including Healthcare, Business, Education, and Daily Life (as shown in Figure 6.5). Many systems work automatically using learned patterns. It reduces human effort and saves time.
Use of Machine Learning in Healthcare

In healthcare, machine learning helps analyze medical data and supports disease detection and diagnosis. For example, it can help detect cancerous cells in medical images, identify early signs of Alzheimer's disease or dementia, and assist in the diagnosis of cardiovascular diseases. Doctors can use these results to plan better and more timely treatments.

blocks.text: Use of Machine Learning in Business

Businesses use machine learning to understand customer behavior. It helps predict sales and market trends. Businesses use it for inventory management. Examples include detecting fraud in financial systems, customer services through robots or chatbots, and suggesting products to customers. Marketing strategies become more effective using machine learning. Business decisions become data-driven. This improves profit and efficiency.
Use of Machine Learning In Education

In education, machine learning improves learning systems. It helps track students' performance to improve their grades. Personalized learning content is provided. Attendance and assessment systems become smarter. Learning outcomes improve.

Machine learning is used in daily life activities. Mobile phones use it for face recognition. Voice assistants understand spoken commands. Social media shows personalized content. Email services filter spam messages. Navigation apps suggest routes. Online platforms recommend videos and music. Smart devices use machine learning and daily tasks become easier and faster.
